Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning public notice of settlements of environmental and public health enforcement actions.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to public notice of settlements of environmentaland public health enforcement actions; adding a new section to chapter43.21A RCW; adding a new section to chapter 43.23 RCW; adding a newsection to chapter 43.70 RCW; adding a new section to chapter 76.09RCW; and adding a new section to chapter 77.55 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.21A RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Within ten days of entering into any settlement in a civilenforcement action that the department has instituted for allegedviolation of an environmental or public health law or permit, thedepartment must post the settlement on its internet web site. (2) For purposes of this section: (a) "Environmental or public health law or permit" means thefollowing laws, rules implementing the laws, and permits issuedpursuant to the laws or rules: (i) Chapter 70.94 RCW, the Washington clean air act; (ii) Chapter 70.95 RCW, regarding solid waste management; (iii) Chapter 70.95J RCW, regarding municipal sewage sludge; p. 1 SSB 5051 (iv) Chapter 70.105 RCW, the hazardous waste management act; (v) Chapter 88.46 RCW, regarding vessel oil spill prevention andresponse; (vi) Chapters 90.03, 90.14, 90.22, and 90.44 RCW, regarding surfaceand groundwater permits, change certificates, minimum water flows andlevels, and water rights abandonment and relinquishment actions; (vii) Chapter 90.46 RCW, regarding reclaimed water use; (viii) Chapter 90.48 RCW, regarding water pollution control; (ix) Chapter 90.56 RCW, regarding oil and hazardous substance spillprevention and response; and (x) Chapter 90.76 RCW, regarding underground storage tanks. (b) "Settlement" means an agreement partially or entirely resolvingliability of an alleged violator.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.23 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Within ten days of entering into any settlement in a civilenforcement action that the department has instituted for allegedviolation of an environmental or public health law or permit, thedepartment must post the settlement on its internet web site. (2) For purposes of this section: (a) "Environmental or public health law or permit" means thefollowing laws, rules implementing the laws, and permits issuedpursuant to the laws or rules: (i) Chapter 15.58 RCW, the Washington pesticide control act; and (ii) Chapter 90.64 RCW, regarding dairy nutrient management. (b) "Settlement" means an agreement partially or entirely resolvingliability of an alleged violator.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.70 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Within ten days of entering into any settlement of a civilenforcement action that the department has instituted for allegedviolation of a public health law or permit, the department must postthe settlement on its internet web site. (2) For purposes of this section: (a) "Public health law or permit" means the following laws, rules SSB 5051 p. 2 implementing the laws, and permits issued pursuant to the laws orrules: (i) Chapters 70.118 and 70.118B RCW, regarding onsite sewagedisposal; and (ii) Chapters 70.119 and 70.119A RCW, regarding public watersystems. (b) "Settlement" means an agreement partially or entirely resolvingliability of an alleged violator.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 76.09 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Within ten days of entering into any settlement in a civilenforcement action that the department has instituted for allegedviolation of this chapter, a rule implementing this chapter, or apermit issued pursuant to this chapter or such a rule, the departmentmust post the settlement on its internet web site. (2) For purposes of this section, "settlement" means an agreementpartially or entirely resolving liability of an alleged violator.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 77.55 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Within ten days of entering into any settlement in a civilenforcement action that the department has instituted for allegedviolation of this chapter, a rule implementing this chapter, or apermit issued pursuant to this chapter or such a rule, the departmentmust post the settlement on its internet web site. (2) For purposes of this section, "settlement" means an agreementpartially or entirely resolving liability of an alleged violator.
